components.name: .Rating/Star
components.description: Single star for Rating. Fill = Empty | Half | Full × Size = S | M | L (size/icon/2·3·4) = 9 variants. Empty uses the Stroke icon on color/border/neutral/strong; Full uses Solid (documented exception) on color/foreground/rating (≥3:1, WCAG 1.4.11); Half clips Solid over Stroke.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Read-only rating of any item — products, courses, places, apps, services. Variant = Stars (Value 0–5 in 0.5 steps) | Compact (one star + score) × Size = S | M | L = 36 variants. Score and Count are text props (default "4.5"; format decimals by locale in code); hide them with Show score / Show count. Built from .Rating/Star.
